name: skill-surgeon
description: Examines, explains, and customizes the skills you already have — ones you built, downloaded, or forgot you had. In single-skill mode it produces a full diagnostic (what it is for, how it triggers, the steps it follows, its dependencies, and anything surprising in a third-party skill), then proposes customizations grounded in what your AI platform knows about you, and applies the edits you approve — always with a backup first. In sweep mode it audits every installed skill and returns a fleet report: which are high-value, which overlap, which are stale, which warrant surgery. Use to understand, vet, audit, tune, personalize, or modify an existing skill, even when the user doesn't say "skill". Trigger phrases include "what does this skill do", "analyze this skill", "customize this skill", "audit my skills", "what skills do I have", "skill checkup", "is this skill safe", "I downloaded this skill", "make this skill mine". For building a skill from scratch, use a skill-creation tool instead.
